item.title: US Factory Orders Rise Most in 6 Months
item.description: New orders for US manufactured goods rose by 2.7% from the previous month to a seasonally adjusted $621.6 billion in November of 2025, rebounding from the revised 1.2% drop in the previous month, the sharpest increase in six months. item.title: MABUX: Bunker Prices To Keep Rising Next Week
item.description: Following the results of the 5th week, global bunker indices published by MABUX continued their upward trajectory. item.title: Greece Credit Growth Rises 5.5% in December
item.description: Total credit extended to the Greek economy increased by 5.5% year-on-year in December 2025 from 5.0% in the previous month. Credit to the private sector rose to 7.9% from 7.2% in November. item.title: India’s economy forecast to grow 6.8%-7.2% in next fiscal year
item.description: India’s economy is expected to grow between 6.8% and 7.2% in the fiscal year starting in April, according to government forecasts released Thursday.
